name: Bruisers 2D Boxing
detailed_description:
Bruisers 2D Boxing

Step into the ring and fight your way to the top in Bruisers 2D Boxing — a gritty, retro-styled boxing RPG where every punch counts and every decision shapes your career.

Welcome to the unforgiving world of professional boxing. Build your legacy from the ground up — train hard, fight smart, and manage the life of an up-and-coming fighter chasing glory. With in-depth 2D boxing action and a rich career mode, Bruisers 2D Boxing captures the raw intensity of the sport like never before.

Features:

  • Realism based 2D Boxing – Jabs, straights, hooks, uppercuts and overhands. Choose your punch selection. Master timing, counters, slipping punches, head movement and parrying to edge the upper hand. Stances change to in-fighting if you get up close and personal with your opponent. Slick style, Bully style and Balanced style - 3 different boxing styles allow for different methods of boxing. Tie up your opponent and deliver punches in the clinch to wear them down, before the referee steps in.

  • Career Mode with RPG Progression – Start from nothing and take on the amateurs to raise your skills against whoever is placed against you,  become preofessional and climb the ranks by training, winning fights, and making tough choices. Want a new challenge? Take on the underground bareknuckle leagues. The choice is yours.

  • Train, Eat, Survive – Balance workouts, job shifts, and nutrition to stay healthy, level up and make money to fund your needs between fights.

  • Injury and Health Management – Push too hard and you’ll pay the price. Stay sharp and recover smart.

  • Retro Visuals, Modern Depth – A throwback art style combined with modern gameplay systems and detail.

Whether you're a hardcore fight fan or just love a gritty, underdog story with old-school flavor, Bruisers 2D Boxing brings to you the chance to create your own boxing journey.

short_description: Bruisers 2D Boxing is a gritty, retro-style boxing RPG where you fight your way from the streets to the championship. Train hard, manage your life outside the ring, and master realistic 2D boxing mechanics in a deep, career-driven experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700K CPU @ 4.20GHz 4.20 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Some fights can end in lots of blood on the boxing mat. Boxing can be a violent sport, so depictions of that will be represented as such. Some choices allow the use of illegal performance enhancing drugs to improve performance of your training. Some choices allow the use of illegal tampering of equipment to enhance in fight performance. Some depictions of gambling, with betting/casino games.
